modmenu.descriptionTranslation.the-starr: A server-side leaderboard system with six built-in and unlimited custom JEXL boards.
starrylist.command.console_help: Use /starry boards to list active boards. Player display preferences require a player.
starrylist.command.display_default: Your display now follows the server default.
starrylist.command.display_updated: Your personal board display was updated.
starrylist.command.invalid_board: One or more board IDs are invalid or disabled; nothing changed.
starrylist.command.cannot_remove_last: A custom profile cannot be empty. Use /starry display hide instead.
starrylist.command.invalid_board_or_inde: The board is not selected or the target index is invalid.
starrylist.admin.help: Use /starryadmin reload, score, profile, or prune.
starrylist.admin.reload_failed: Reload failed; the active configuration and display state were preserved.
starrylist.admin.profile_reset: Reset %s player display profile(s) to DEFAULT.
starrylist.admin.prune_preview: %s orphan objective(s) would be deleted: %s. Run /starryadmin prune confirm to continue.
starrylist.config.title: The-Starry-List
starrylist.config.local_only: This screen edits this client's local config/starrylist.json only. It affects single-player or a LAN integrated server, not a remote dedicated server.
starrylist.config.script_warning: SECURITY: Config editors have Minecraft console and operating-system account authority. Never install untrusted scripts. Slow event shell commands freeze the server; prefer scheduled sources.
starrylist.config.custom_board_entries.t: Add, remove, reorder, or duplicate complete board JSON objects, then save and reopen before structured editing. Each sources array supports trigger, update, intervalSeconds, and script.
starrylist.config.script.invalid: The JEXL script does not compile.
starrylist.config.script.editor.title: StarryList JEXL Editor
starrylist.config.all_summary: Language: %s | Admin level: %s | Rotation: %s/%ss | Custom boards: %s
starrylist.config.save_success.detail: The local JSON configuration was validated and applied.
